scope.excluded: No changes to Game, loaders, schema, actor runtime, source assets, historical verification fixtures, build or deployment.

uiContract.storage: Local packages persist in the current browser; other devices need the same package installed first.
uiContract.import: Snapshot and clear the native File input synchronously; validate ZIP/GLB using npc-library; serialize via fileEdits; refresh reference catalog and definitions without committing scene/history.
uiContract.metadata: Entry hydration, subscription and palette search do not load models or open the iframe. Models remain lazy until explicit Add/Load.
uiContract.motions: Use reference-catalog NPC labels, exact clip durations and defaultClip; deduplicate idle aliases while retaining all20 source clips.
uiContract.cleanup: Remove metadata subscription and window focus listener on Studio destroy.
uiContract.guide: Exact source labels document Settings > 개발도구 켜기, the in-game developer launcher, nearby NPC/monster entry, NPC add/motion/apply/cancel flow. Guide-only final update after Studio freeze; native HTML/exact-label checks pass.

newNpcCases: Built-in blacksmith has separate NPC category,20 labeled clips and defaultIdle_02 with zero startup model/iframe commands.
Visible native picker validates a real ZIP containing skinned GLB, registers metadata, preserves scene/history and never executes review.js; explicit Add uses imported clip data.
External library subscriptions and metadata refresh reveal GLB entries without changing scene; disposal unsubscribes.
Invalid packages and unavailable browser storage preserve scene and permit retry.
verification.repairCases: Six actual Studio/Game/SceneHost/native transport tests remain green: typing/polling, Enter/button/change, real scene/project Files, same-file reselection, invalid/cancel/New isolation, exact-center Add with unchanged camera.
verification.adapter: New repair test imports C's current verification-native-fixture.mjs resolving actual main.toolState. Historical fixtures remain untouched.
verification.diffCheck: PASS for all owned tracked sources/test changes; all owned sources/new tests end with LF.
verification.limitations: No browser automation, screenshot, native OS file-dialog visual claim, build or deployment. NPC focused UI tests use real parser/store with native DOM and controlled command transport; C independently verifies actual runtime/model chain.
